{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Councillor Halgrive]] outside the [[East Ardougne]] church. Ensure that you have at least 1 empty inventory slot. {{Chat option|1What's wrong?|1I can do that for you.}}
*Talk to [[Doctor Orbon]] in the church. {{Chat option|1Okay, I'll take it.}}
*Put on the [[plague jacket]] and [[plague trousers|trousers]] and go to the enclosure north-west of the Ardougne north bank.
*Pick up & wield the [[cattleprod]] next to the incinerator.
*There are sheep to the north-west (blue), north (yellow), east (green), and south (red) of the incinerator.
*Prod one sheep of each colour through the gate.
** Blue sheep
** Yellow sheep
** Green sheep
** Red sheep
*Feed your sheep [[sheep feed]] until they're all dead.
*Pick up the bones and use them on the incinerator.
*Return to [[Councillor Halgrive]] to complete the quest.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
